units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 653:3">Yalk. Ps. 653</cite> <he>שְׁתִיַּית עולם</he>, v. <cite ref="M02997"><he>מַשְׁתִּית</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 653:3">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:2">Yoma V, 2</cite> <he>משניטל הארון … וש׳ וכ׳</he> since the Ark disappeared, there was a stone in its place, … which was called foundation stone; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b">Snh. 26ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:3:3">Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ</cite> <he>למה … אבן ש׳ שממנה הושתה העולם</he> why was it called foundation stone? Because from it was the world founded (or started, v. <cite ref="U02093"><he>שָׁתָה</he> II</cite>); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:4">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 54b:2">Yoma 54ᵇ</cite> <he>שממנה הושתת וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:8">Tosef. Yoma III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:6">II</cite>), 6; a. e.
